item.title: The Wordless Animal Dances of ZooZoo Present Smart Theater for All Ages
item.description: ZooZoo will please adults and kids alike. by John Rudoff Imago Theatre’s current production, ZooZoo is an easy concept to understand: It's movement work. Dancers in animal costumes cavort in ways that both call in actual animal movements and human characteristics given to animal forms. At the same time, when one watches the show, ZooZoo feels like a marvelous puzzle. What genre is this? How should we describe it?
